purpose: confirmation of the Section 4.3 demand results on downstream proteins never scored by this project
rule: rows of the released manifest with stage1 != 1, preferring the source dataset's own test split

membrane_soluble.origin: unused rows of the source test split

subcellular_localization.origin: unused rows of the source validation split

fluorescence.origin: unused rows of the source test split

stability.origin: unused rows of the source test split

ec_classification.origin: unused rows of the source test split

go_mf.origin: unused rows of the source validation split

go_bp.origin: unused rows of the source validation split

excluded.solubility: no unused rows; the whole manifest was scored
excluded.ppi_affinity: no unused rows; the whole manifest was scored

not_claimed: these proteins come from the same source datasets as the scored rows, so this establishes that no descriptor, threshold or naming rule was developed against them, and nothing about pretraining exposure, fold novelty or homology separation

protocol.fit: the released stage-1 training rows and their heads, unchanged
protocol.erasure: LEACE on the conditional composition residual, the released construction
protocol.controls: sham erasure of the permuted property; permuted and alternative descriptors for the add-back
protocol.no_refitting: no threshold, property or rule may change after this file is written

hypotheses.claim: Erasing linear access to amino-acid composition costs the retrained head more than the sham erasure does, on membrane and soluble and on subcellular localisation.
hypotheses.decision: confirmed on a task if the mean conditional effect is positive and the sign test over the panel is one-sided p < 0.05

hypotheses.claim: The named descriptor repairs its own erasure more than it repairs the sham, and the permuted copy and the other structural blocks do not.
hypotheses.released: R = +0.036, +0.015 for composition; within 0.003 of zero for both controls
hypotheses.decision: confirmed on a task if mean R for composition is positive on every panel encoder and exceeds the mean R of both controls

hypotheses.claim: Where the released run named nothing, nothing is named here either: GO-BP stays below the magnitude floor and stability does not hold in sign across the panel.
hypotheses.released: GO-BP +0.014 below the floor of 0.02; stability +0.070 fails the sign test
hypotheses.decision: confirmed if neither task passes the released naming rule on the held-out cohort

hypotheses.claim: Remote homology remains a bound: no property reaches the magnitude floor.
hypotheses.released: largest effect +0.005, every upper limit at or below +0.009
hypotheses.decision: confirmed if every Holm-adjusted one-sided 95% upper limit stays below 0.02
